result.title: CARE: Grounded Recursive Self-Improvement for Production Customer-Service Agents
result.summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) in production agents involves transforming accumulated experience into reliable model updates while adapting to evolving business policies. We present CARE (Customer-service Agent Retrospective and Evolve), a grounded RSI framework that operationalizes this process in customer service. Its goal is to replace a frontier proprietary incumbent with an in-house mid-sized model that continues learning after deployment. After a one-time cold start on governed production traces, the current model serves production traffic alongside the incumbent, and its own failures drive the next update. A 24/7 inspection process establishes failures through evidence-blinded, independently reviewed judgments. Attribution separates model errors from defects in Skills, tools, or the harness, routing component failures to repair. Model-attributable trajectories are truncated at the first erroneous decision and paired with verified repairs. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) then updates the model using the same model as teacher, with the diagnosis and repair supplied as privileged information unavailable to the student. To support continued evolution as business requirements change, training mixes failures from different Skill/SOP versions, each judged against the policy in force when it occurred. Candidates run an executable simulation test compiled from the latest SOP and then frozen, followed by offline inspection of the resulting traces. Promotion requires a combined simulation-and-inspection score at least at parity with the deployed version, confirmation through an online comparison with the incumbent, and human approval.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 CARE 生产客服代理的递归自我改进框架：通过持续巡检与独立复核判定失败，归因区分模型错误与 Skill／工具／harness 缺陷，将模型相关轨迹截断于首个错误决策并配对修复，再用同一模型的 on-policy self-distillation 更新中等规模模型，诊断与修复作为学生不可见的 privileged information，并以仿真、离线巡检、线上对比和人工审批决定是否上线。
AI.relevance_reason: 不含视觉或 latent 推理，但「截断于首个错误决策＋配对修复的 privileged 自蒸馏」可能为 LVR 的轨迹训练、贡献分配与监督信号设计提供可核查的方法线索。
